config.permissions.autoApproveReadOnly: Allow read-only tools (Read / Glob / Grep) without asking. Writes and command execution are always confirmed.
config.claudeCodeExecutable: Path to the Claude Code executable to use. When empty, the copy bundled with Nimbus is used.
config.permissions.showDiffBeforeApprova: Show the change in a diff editor before asking to approve a tool that edits files.
config.permissions.offerPartialAccept: When a proposed edit touches two or more places, offer "Accept Some" as an approval choice. Changes you leave out stay as they were.
config.permissions.queueApprovals: Queue approvals in the "Awaiting Approval" view instead of asking in a modal. With several sessions running at once, this shows in one place which session is blocked on what.
config.permissions.alwaysAllow: Tools to allow without asking. "Always Allow This Kind from Now On" adds entries here. Write them as Read (the whole tool), Write(*.md) (by extension), or Bash(npm test) (command prefix). Irreversible operations such as rm -rf are always confirmed regardless of these rules.
config.notifications.enabled: Use OS notifications for turn completion and for approvals that need you.
config.notifications.onlyWhenUnfocused: Notify only when the Nimbus window is not in front. On by default so notifications do not land on top of the screen you are already looking at.
config.usage.costLimitUsd: Spending limit per session, in USD. Nimbus warns before you reach it and suggests stopping once you pass it. 0 means no limit.
config.usage.warnAtPercent: What percentage of the spending limit triggers the first warning.
config.safety.blockProtectedReads: Refuse reads of sensitive files (.env, private keys, and so on) without asking. On by default, because content that has been read cannot be taken back.
config.safety.protectedPaths: Glob patterns for files that must not be read. When empty, the built-in list is used (.env, *.pem, ~/.ssh, and so on). A leading ! makes a pattern an exception.
config.safety.scanBeforeSend: Check outgoing text for anything that looks like a credential before sending it.
config.tasks.maxConcurrent: Maximum number of tasks (Claude sessions) running at once. Tasks past the limit wait and start automatically as slots free up.
config.lsp.enabled: Give Claude go-to-definition, find-references, type info, call hierarchy, and diagnostics as tools (read-only; never asks for approval).
config.editor.codeLens: Show "Ask Nimbus" above functions and classes.
config.lsp.groundLibraryVersions: For libraries named in an instruction, attach the version actually in use, so Claude does not work from memory.
config.lsp.attachSignatures: For functions and classes named in an instruction, attach their real signatures before sending, so Claude does not guess.
config.lsp.maxAttachedSignatures: Maximum number of signatures to attach to a single instruction.
config.debug.notifyOnException: When the debugger stops on an exception, offer to hand the paused location to the session. Plain breakpoints do not prompt.
config.debug.exposeState: While a debug session is paused, give Claude the call stack and variable values as a read-only tool. Expressions cannot be evaluated.
config.lsp.verifyEdits: After Claude edits a file, check only the type errors that appeared during that turn.
config.lsp.verifyEdits.enum.1: Notify when type errors increase, and let you choose whether to send them back.
config.lsp.verifyEdits.enum.2: Send type errors back to the session automatically, up to a limit.
config.lsp.verifyIncludes: How much to send back when checking after an edit.
config.lsp.verifyIncludes.enum.1: Also send back lint and analyzer warnings (for automatic loops).
config.lsp.maxAutoFixes: Maximum number of automatic send-backs for type errors, per session. Stops a loop that never converges.
config.claudeMd.suggestRepeats: When you keep writing the same instruction, offer to add it to CLAUDE.md.
config.clipboard.suggestOnError: When what you copied looks like an error message, offer to investigate it. Turning this on reads the clipboard the moment you return to the window; the contents are never displayed.
config.terminal.captureFailures: When a terminal command fails, offer a notification that sends its output to the session.
config.terminal.maxOutputLines: Maximum number of terminal output lines to send to the session, counting from the end.
config.terminal.autoRetryBuilds: When a build or type check fails, have the session fix it without asking and rerun the same command in the same terminal, up to a limit. Only commands you typed yourself are rerun.
config.terminal.maxBuildRetries: Maximum number of automatic build retries. Stops a loop that never converges.
config.tests.captureFailures: When tests fail, offer a notification that sends the failing test names, locations, and messages to the session.
config.tests.maxFailures: Maximum number of failing tests to send to the session.
config.dialogue.confirmVaguePrompt: Before running a vague instruction, ask about what is missing. Nothing is asked when the instruction names a file or similar.
config.hotReload.enabled: When a turn ends and the target files changed, reload, take a screenshot, and send it to the session automatically. Off by default.
config.hotReload.reloadCommand: Shell command that triggers the reload. When empty, only a screenshot is taken.
config.hotReload.screenshotCommand: Shell command that takes the screenshot. {file} is replaced with the output path (for example: xcrun simctl io booted screenshot {file}).
config.hotReload.extensions: Reload only when a file with one of these extensions changed. When empty, any change triggers a reload.
config.hotReload.maxRounds: Maximum number of automatic rounds per instruction.
config.context.pinnedFiles: Files to always include as session context, relative to the workspace. Up to 60 KB in total; anything beyond that is dropped.
config.context.budgetTokens: Context tokens this session may use. Nimbus warns at 80% and suggests compacting once you pass it. 0 means no budget.
config.agents.models: Model to use per subagent (for example: {"explorer": "haiku"}). Only the ones you name are changed.
config.git.baseBranch: What "See How the Branch Looks" compares against. When empty, main is used (or master if there is no main). If your fork's main tracks upstream, name the branch you follow instead.
config.build.command: Command run by "Time the Build and Compare with Last Run" (for example: flutter build apk, npm run build).
config.build.artifact: Path to the artifact whose size is measured, relative to the project. When empty, only time is compared.
config.policy.profile: The approval policy in effect. Switching it changes permission mode, auto-approval, and sandboxing together.
config.audit.enabled: Record who had which agent do what, in a JSONL file per day. Credentials are masked before anything is written.
config.team.bundlePath: Where the settings bundle shared with your team lives. Commit it to the repository and Nimbus can pick up updates.
config.persona: How Nimbus talks in the cockpit. Takes effect from the next session.
config.tests.command: Command that runs the tests. When empty, Nimbus asks each time. Only TAP output (node --test and similar) can be read.
config.localOnly: Stop the audit log, hot-reload command execution, and OS notifications. Traffic to Claude itself and MCP connections are not stopped.
config.focusMode: Silence completion notifications. Approvals still get through, because those mean work has stopped.
config.safety.warnOnGeneratedEdit: Stop an attempt to edit generated files (*.g.dart, *.freezed.dart, lockfiles, and so on) directly, and say what to edit instead.
config.generate.offerAfterSave: When you save a source file that has generated output (model.dart and similar), offer to regenerate. Off by default.
config.clarifyVagueJapanese: When an instruction is vague — a demonstrative with no target, a standard with no measure — ask once before sending.
command.exportGif: Export the Session as a GIF
config.gif.width: GIF width in pixels. Height keeps the original ratio.
command.pluginActions: Use an Instruction Added by an Extension
config.managedPolicy: The ceiling your organization sets on permissions. Limits written here cannot be loosened by the user — only narrowed. Intended to be delivered per machine, for example through MDM.
config.voice.modelPath: Where the model lives, when you use whisper.cpp. Other transcription tools do not need this.
